check: un_wpp population vs Our World in Data
purpose: Validates OUR parsing (thousands-to-persons conversion, ISO3 join, Country/Area filter), NOT the UN's estimates. OWID's modern population series is itself UN WPP 2024, so agreement is expected by construction and disagreement indicates a pipeline bug.
roundingOnlyNote: 25 comparisons exceeded the relative tolerance but differed by fewer than 1000 people. These are microstates where WPP's thousands-precision publication makes sub-2% relative agreement unattainable, and are not defects.
